result.reason: The revised cap and uncapped carve-outs match the preferred position, but the operative language does not include the required mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages. The payment-obligation clarification also remains limited to undisputed “Fees” for conforming Services, while “Fees” is defined solely as the USD 12,000 Implementation Fee, rather than covering all Customer payment obligations. In addition, the cap is measured from the event giving rise to the claim rather than the claim itself, and “all amounts” is broader and less precise than fees. The edit is otherwise narrow and professionally structured.
